newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul bourse suspends trading in Kia Group shares.
newsitem.headline: Seoul bourse suspends trading in Kia Group shares.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange halted trading in all six listed Kia Group shares for the afternoon session on Tuesday following rumours the group had applied to its creditors for a bail-out.
An exchange official said trading of the shares would resume on Wednesday. He said the group, the nation's eighth largest conglomerate, would soon clarify the market rumours.
Earlier a central bank spokesman confirmed that Kia's creditor banks would officially announce details of a decision to designate Kia Group for bail-out at 0530 GMT.
